mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate used in equity valuation models, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is low, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% over 3 months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 (thousand units) signals housing market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deepening economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During severe supply contractions (INDPRO declining more than 2.0% in a month), production disruptions reduce corporate profits and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during severe supply contractions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
